name: guardrail-mods
description: Claude Code mods that hold Claude to accessibility, design-token, quality and secret-handling rules.

scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . && for mod in mods/*/; do claude plugin validate "$mod" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for mod in mods/*/; do claude plugin test "$mod" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm test
